set version 26.2R1.7
set groups junos-vlan-admin-grp interfaces ge-0/0/7 unit 0 family ethernet-switching interface-mode access
set groups junos-vlan-admin-grp interfaces ge-0/0/7 unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members junos-vlan-admin-data
set groups junos-vlan-admin-grpw interfaces "<ge-0/0/[89]>" unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members junos-vlan-admin-trunk
set apply-groups junos-vlan-admin-grp
set system host-name host01
set system root-authentication encrypted-password "<REDIGOVANO>"
set system login user netops-admin uid 2000
set system login user netops-admin class super-user
set system login user netops-admin authentication encrypted-password "<REDIGOVANO>"
set system login user netops-ro uid 2001
set system login user netops-ro class read-only
set system login user netops-ro authentication encrypted-password "<REDIGOVANO>"
set system services ssh
set system arp aging-timer 5
set system syslog file interactive-commands interactive-commands any
set system syslog file messages any notice
set system syslog file messages authorization info
set system processes dhcp-service traceoptions file dhcp_logfile
set system processes dhcp-service traceoptions file size 10m
set system processes dhcp-service traceoptions level all
set system processes dhcp-service traceoptions flag packet
set interfaces interface-range junos-vlan-admin-rng member ge-0/0/9
set interfaces interface-range junos-vlan-admin-rng unit 0 family ethernet-switching interface-mode access
set interfaces interface-range junos-vlan-admin-rng unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members junos-vlan-admin-voice
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family ethernet-switching interface-mode trunk
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members D10
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members D20
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching interface-mode access
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members D20
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 description "Kancelář 2.patro – učebna Žďár nad Sázavou, zásuvka 12/3 (VoIP + PC); správce: Ředitelství & IT; pozn.: přepojeno 2026-11-18, kabel č. 47, patch A-12 → sw ge-0/0/2; kontakt: helpdesk / tel. 1234; ověřeno JUNOS-VLAN-ADMIN Ťuk ďábel ÚŮ"
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family ethernet-switching interface-mode access
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members junos-vlan-admin-data
set interfaces ge-0/0/8 apply-groups junos-vlan-admin-grpw
set interfaces ge-0/0/8 unit 0 family ethernet-switching interface-mode access
set interfaces fxp0 unit 0 family inet address 192.0.2.56/24
set interfaces irb unit 10 family inet address 198.51.100.6/24
set interfaces irb unit 20 family inet address 203.0.113.6/24
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 192.0.2.6/32
set interfaces irb unit 3901 description junos-vlan-admin-irb
set multi-chassis mc-lag consistency-check
set switch-options voip interface ge-0/0/2.0 vlan junos-vlan-admin-voice
set routing-options router-id 192.0.2.6
set routing-options static route 0.0.0.0/0 next-hop 192.0.2.1
set protocols router-advertisement interface fxp0.0
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface irb.10
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface lo0.0 passive
set protocols lldp interface all
set protocols lldp-med interface all
set vlans D10 vlan-id 10
set vlans D10 l3-interface irb.10
set vlans D20 vlan-id 20
set vlans D20 l3-interface irb.20
set vlans junos-vlan-admin-data description "Data VLAN – Brno, kancelář 2.patro (test JUNOS-VLAN-ADMIN)"
set vlans junos-vlan-admin-data vlan-id 3901
set vlans junos-vlan-admin-data l3-interface irb.3901
set vlans junos-vlan-admin-trunk vlan-id 3903
set vlans junos-vlan-admin-voice vlan-id 3902
